misprints.note: comma printed after 'o' where a full stop is expected
ποεῖσθαι without iota (a real variant spelling); acute on περί before an enclitic, kept as printed

uncertain.note: The breathing and accent on ἐν are blurred. Read as smooth breathing with acute (ἔν). The τ of τινι is broken and looks like ι.

The accents of this first line fall at the bottom of the previous strip's image: an acute over the ε of φέρειν and one over τι. τινος has no accent, which fits the rule for an enclitic followed by another enclitic.
The print shows διάσιασις because the τ is broken. Transcribed as διάστασις.
No breathing is visible on ο after the parenthesis, so it is kept without one, as in the print. The same applies to (δι)ορίζειν in 0397_01.
